metadata.description: A collection of custom Agent Skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: open-in-editor
plugins.description: Open a file from the current Git worktree in the user's chosen editor: VS Code or Cursor.

plugins.name: stacked-prs
plugins.description: Manage stacked PR branches - split large changes into small, reviewable PRs, update branches after base merge, and cascade changes downstream.

plugins.name: session-retrospective
plugins.description: Run a structured Keep/Problem/Try retrospective at session end, cross-reference past retrospectives for recurring patterns, then propose memory entries, doc updates, and skill candidates.

plugins.name: session-cleanup
plugins.description: Claude Code デスクトップアプリのセッションを分類し、終わったものをアーカイブし、残りを報告する。

plugins.name: delegated-work
plugins.description: Own substantial tasks through early clarification, bounded parallel preparation, independent execution, and verified delivery.

plugins.name: eval-review
plugins.description: Turn local CSV, JSON, or JSONL files into one self-contained offline HTML page for reviewing evaluation results: compare model A vs B with regressions first, decide releases against stated criteria, share an experiment's result against a hypothesis with a written report, label fact-check items with keyboard shortcuts and export CSV, or triage feedback by category and status.

plugins.name: shared-doc-writing
plugins.description: 他人に読ませて反応を得るための共有文書（検討案・設計案・提案・調査結果・PR 説明・Notion / Google Docs・README・仕様・参照資料）を書く・直すときの考え方。言語に依らず、書き始める前に決めること、冒頭に置くもの、指摘が返る形、確かさの書き分け、一覧と文の使い分け、推敲、共有メッセージを定める。場面に応じて references/logic.md、references/japanese-prose.md、references/updating.md、references/pull-request.md、references/sources.md を読む。単体で入れても壊れる参照は無い。Partly derived from k16shikano's gist (used with permission).
